text:
sec-bot: SECURITY ADVISORY: libproxy-httpx v3.8.0 contains a header-parsing vuln (high). Affects Dedicated + Private runtime images built before 2024-07-01. Immediate mitigations required.

sec-bot: REQUIRED: 1) Rebuild runtime images with libproxy-httpx >=3.8.1 and publish patched tags. 2) Rotate long-lived connector/service-account keys issued before 2024-07-01. 3) Deploy temporary header-normalization WAF rule at edge. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/sec/runbooks/libhttpx (internal)

marta: Quick Q: is Hosted impacted?

oliver: Hosted fleet already pulled patched base earlier today — Hosted NOT impacted. Dedicated clusters and Private images that used the older base are at risk. I'm listing affected clusters now.

ashley: Patching plan: build patched runtime tag, then rolling update per-cluster with maxUnavailable=1. I'll start with us-west-2 dedicated pools. Smoke tests after each region.

ops-bot: Scheduling connector rotation job: rotate-173900 for us-west-2, eu-west-1. Start window 2024-04-05T02:00Z. Will report completion per region.

dave: Detection helpers for Private teams: grep for images on hosts and scan image manifests for libproxy-httpx references. Example: `docker images | grep libproxy-httpx`

emily: I'll draft an internal advisory for affected accounts and CS. Hold customer outbound until we reach ~80% cluster patching unless any customer-visible issues arise.

marta: Oncall: 90-min sprints. Leads: @ashley (rollout), @oliver (inventory), @marta (sec verification). Post updates every 30m. Escalate to @vp-security for any customer impact.

ashley: us-west-2 rollout started. Monitoring with `kubectl -n <ns> rollout status deploy/inference` and smoke tests.

ops-bot: Connectors rotated in us-west-2. eu-west-1 rotation in progress.

oliver: Inventory update: ~50% of Dedicated clusters used old base. Continuing enumeration.

emily: Status page draft ready if needed; holding public notice.

marta: Reminder: For Private/on-prem customers, they must rebuild their base and restart services within 24h. If you manage installs, contact customer infra immediately.

ops-bot: eu-west-1 connector rotation complete, keys revoked. Remaining regions scheduled.

ashley: us-west-2 rollout complete, smoke tests green. Proceeding to next region.

emily: Update: 100% of affected Dedicated clusters patched at 1739003600. Ops continuing monitoring.

sec-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem owner: marta. Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/sec/incidents/libhttpx-173900 (internal)
